subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open cross-repo fix PR, port it to a maintainer-editable replacement, or reject the expanded default-stagger behavior?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but an open non-maintainer cross-repo PR already claims the fix and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create another competing fix without a maintainer routing choice.

options.title: Review or adopt the open PR
options.body: Review the fork PR's helper against Croner strict semantics and land or port it if the behavior is acceptable.

options.title: Authorize a replacement PR
options.body: If the fork branch cannot be safely updated, replace it with a narrow OpenClaw PR that credits the source work and closes the stale candidates after replacement exists.

options.title: Reject expanded staggering
options.body: If maintainers decide the documented literal minute-zero behavior is intentional, close this issue and the linked fix attempt with that product rationale.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the open PR
recommendation.body: Review the fork PR's helper against Croner strict semantics and land or port it if the behavior is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the default stagger helper and has the strongest sampled history on the central cron scheduling files.
